_comment: Feeds the weekly Ledger scan (see PIPELINE.md Step 2). 'priority': primary sources are checked every run; secondary when time permits or when a primary item points there. 'role': 'listing' sources are announcement feeds — fetch them and scan items from the last ~10 days (Pass A, look-back). 'role': 'calendar' sources are forward-looking due-date/rate-change pages — fetch them and capture any action/effective date in the next ~45 days (Pass B, look-ahead). A missing 'role' means 'listing'. The look-ahead pass exists because agencies post changes months before they take effect (e.g. a July 1 change announced in April) — triage on the action date, not the posting date.

sources.name: IRS Newsroom — news releases
sources.focus: Due-date changes, disaster relief for California/LA County, new thresholds and credits for pass-throughs and small employers, scam alerts. Skip enforcement press releases and statistics.

sources.name: IRS — Small Business and Self-Employed tax center updates
sources.focus: Guidance changes for Schedule C / 1120-S / 1065 filers; tip reporting; payroll credits.

sources.name: CDTFA — news releases
sources.focus: Sales & use tax changes, interest rates, filing extensions/relief. Restaurants, grocery, gas stations, and wholesalers all live under CDTFA rules.

sources.name: CDTFA — special notices
sources.focus: The highest-signal CDTFA source: rate changes by district (check LA County cities), industry-specific rule changes, fuel tax (service stations), CRV changes (grocery).

sources.name: FinCEN — news releases
sources.focus: BOI/Corporate Transparency Act rulemaking — the blog has a standing promise to cover changes (see boi-reporting-2026-california-llcs). Also scam alerts aimed at small businesses.

sources.name: FTB — Tax News
sources.focus: CA conformity to federal changes, PTET (pass-through elective tax) deadlines, LLC fee/annual tax announcements, CA-only relief.

sources.name: EDD — payroll tax rates and employer news
sources.focus: SDI rate (no wage cap), UI rates, DE 44 updates. Check around year-end especially.

sources.name: CA DIR — press releases
sources.focus: Statewide minimum wage announcements (usually July–August for the following Jan 1), sector minimums (fast food, health care), exempt salary threshold implications.

sources.name: City of Los Angeles — Office of Wage Standards
sources.focus: City of LA minimum wage (adjusts July 1) and hotel/airport sector wages. Pair with county/Pasadena/Glendale rates when writing local-wage articles.

sources.name: Thomson Reuters — UltraTax CS alerts and release notes
sources.focus: Only client-visible impacts: e-file system outages/openings, new document requirements, major form availability delays. Internal software changes are never article material.

sources.name: CDTFA — Explanation of Tax Rate Changes
sources.focus: Forward-looking: district sales/use tax rate changes organized by future operative date (quarter starts: Jan 1 / Apr 1 / Jul 1 / Oct 1), with the voter measure behind each. Check for LA-County jurisdictions (Glendale, Pasadena, unincorporated county, Foothill corridor) before each quarter — this is the earliest warning of a local rate change.

sources.name: IRS — Online Tax Calendar (businesses & self-employed)
sources.focus: Upcoming federal business filing/deposit due dates by quarter. Use to time deadline reminders (estimated taxes, payroll deposits, information returns) with lead time rather than after the fact.

sources.name: FTB — Due dates for businesses
sources.focus: California entity filing and payment due dates: corporation/LLC/partnership returns, LLC annual $800 tax and LLC fee, PTET election/payment timing. Pair with the IRS calendar for federal+CA deadline articles.

sources.name: CDTFA — Filing Dates for Sales & Use Tax Returns
sources.focus: Recurring sales/use tax return and prepayment due dates by filing frequency (monthly, quarterly, quarterly-prepay, yearly). Use to time filing-deadline reminders for restaurants, retailers, and gas stations ahead of the date.
